title: Pillow-block drive line
one_line: An IEC 80-style foot motor driving a 25 mm keyed line shaft through an L-type jaw coupling, carried by two UCP205-style pillow blocks, with an SPA V-belt pulley on the output end, all on a fabricated steel base.
specs: Shaft centre height 80 mm (IEC 80 shaft height); pillow blocks on 44 mm riser pads
IEC 80 B3-style motor (simplified): finned frame, 4 feet A=125 mm / B=100 mm, terminal box + gland, fan cowl, shaft Ø19 x 40 mm keyed 6x6
L-100-style jaw coupling: Ø64 mm hubs, bores 19 / 25 mm with keyways and M6 set screws, 6-leg elastomer spider
Ø25 x 360 mm line shaft, 8x7 keys at coupling and pulley
2 x UCP205-style pillow blocks (H 36.5 mm, 140 x 38 mm base, slots on 105 mm centres, grease nipple), 180 mm apart
UC205-style insert: spherical Ø52 mm outer ring, extended inner ring with 2 M6 set screws, 9 x 7.94 mm balls in a cage, 2 seals
SPA single-groove pulley, 140 mm pitch / 145.5 mm OD, 38 deg groove, keyed + set screw
2 x Ø42 mm shaft collars; M8x40 motor bolts with washers and nuts; M12x40 pillow-block bolts with washers
parameters: shaft (deg): drive-line angle; drives motor rotor and line-shaft revolutes, ball sets at shaft*0.4
interference: 163 pairs, 0 interferences (at shaft = 35 deg; also 0 at 0 deg/143 pairs and 120 deg/165 pairs)
poses: shaft = 35 deg: solve converged, state well, 0 dof (saved pose, hero render)
shaft = 120 deg: solve converged, state well, 0 dof
not_verified: No load, speed, torque, power, belt tension, bearing life or mass computed (no materials set)
Motor is an envelope model (no windings or internal bearings)
Threads not modelled; tapped holes and nuts are plain bores
Spider fastened to hub A rather than floating; ball cage speed is a kinematic ratio only
Insert spherical OD is faceted in a cylindrical bore; no misalignment freedom
Dimensions are typical catalogue values, not one manufacturer's drawing
